description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Baltimore County Public Schools is hiring an Enterprise Resource Planning, Business Systems Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain business systems software that improves staff efficiency and productivity. The role supports Payroll, Finance, HR, and Benefits interfaces and produces reports and documentation about business processes and operations.
ERP Business Systems Software Engineer developing applications and data integrations; supporting Payroll, Finance, and HR interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Under general supervision designs, develops and maintains business systems software solutions that are intended to increase the efficiency and productivity of supported staff
• Generates, compiles, and analyzes a variety of reports and documentation for Information Technology about business processes, operational procedures, and organizational effectiveness
• Supports scheduled vendor and business interfaces for Payroll, Finance, HR and Benefits
• Works on special projects and workgroups
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Defines and documents requirements in close collaboration with Business Clients, Software Engineers and Technical Support team(s)
• Writes and documents process and program specifications. Ensures proper documentation standards and procedures are maintained
• Designs, develops, and maintains data integration applications and solutions using established processes and standard operating procedures. Works with Technical Support team to minimize performance issues
• Coordinates system testing and assists users with acceptance testing to ensure delivered product meets project requirements and system policies
• Facilitates the design, development and maintenance of data and process models
• Works on multiple project requests. With collaboration of manager engages vendors of applications and systems to assist with best practice implementations, scheduling of routine operations, and troubleshooting
• Performs modifications to and maintenance of existing operational programs and procedures by adhering to established SDLC and systems validation policy and standard operating procedures
• Serves as point of contact for resolution of routine software problems
• Designs and documents workflow and makes appropriate recommendations to improve the office's operational effectiveness, including steps required to develop and/or modify automated systems
• Assists in the development of work plans and project organization/documentation
• Monitors status and results of scheduled vendor interfaces and helps troubleshoot issues
• Performs check and stub printing duties onsite for Payroll and Finance processes
• Performs additional duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in job related area
• One year of experience in developing information systems solutions using Microsoft SQL Management Studio, SAP Crystal Reports, or similar reporting tool
• Knowledge of current and emerging technology and Systems Development Methodology
• Thorough knowledge of automated business systems and advanced reporting tools
• Skill in requirements gathering, problem solving, managing projects/programs, effective listening, and the use of technology tools including Microsoft SQL Management Studio and SAP Crystal Reports
• Skill in reviewing and interpreting highly technical information and writing technical materials, documentation
• Skill in speaking persuasively
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Ability to schedule activities, meetings, and/or events; often gather, collate, and/or classify data; and use basic, job-related equipment
• Ability to meet schedules and deadlines
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships
• Ability to implement information technology solutions, manage diverse teams, multi-task and prioritize
• Ability to complete complex project tasks applied to specialized technology to resolve total system problems or applications
• Citizenship, residency or work VISA in United States required

Preferred:
• Oracle HCM/ERP or other enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems support experience is preferred
• Any experience with PowerShell, SSIS, .Net, HTML, VB, or XML considered a plus
